{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p138","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk the emerald steps while the light is soft and the air still cool."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Ancient shrines carved into the cliff, wrapped in jungle and old stories."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A quieter royal temple with stone monuments and a river below."},{"poi_id":"p42","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tiny warung with big flavour and a menu that changes with the market."},{"poi_id":"p43","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Slow down with a proper meal and a view that asks nothing of you."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p36","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Start with the village temple, where the carvings catch the soft light and the air still feels cool."},{"poi_id":"p30","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the monkey forest paths and let the long-tailed locals show you who really runs Ubud."},{"poi_id":"p44","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A small, pretty temple with lotus ponds and a calm that sneaks up on you."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Peek at the old moon drum and the stories carved into stone here."},{"poi_id":"p55","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Grab a plate of rich Balinese mixed rice, the kind of lunch that makes you want a nap."},{"poi_id":"p24","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Skewers of smoky pork satay, simple and exactly what the evening calls for."}]}
